decisions.reason: Restricting the dealer-login button to the top right does not change the founder image or its bottom-of-page placement.
The button-placement decision belongs to the separate dealer-login action Requirement and does not alter the landing page's established content types, image quantity, or screenshot-selection policy.
The dealer-login button placement does not change the hero visualization, depicted controls, image gallery, or mobile-phone presentation.
Changing where the dealer-login button appears does not modify the site's clean minimal SaaS aesthetic, brand-asset use, or style reference.
The client's statement that more copy may be added is not a confirmed copy change, and the dealer-login placement decision does not alter the established hero headline.
The dealer-login button placement has no effect on the Webflow hosting-plan selection rule.
The interface placement decision does not change the website handoff artifact or its destination workspace.
The dealer-login button placement does not affect contact-form submission delivery or recipient email addresses.
